name: spill
description: Read back a tool result whose middle was omitted from the model request. After a prune marker, call {"id":"<8hex>"} (or pass the whole locator line as "text"). {"list":true} lists spill directories.
llm_description: Read a spilled tool result the request pruner omitted. Input: {id} (8 hex from the [spill id=........] line) or {text} containing that locator. Optional {session}. {list:true} lists spill dirs. The saved transcript is unchanged.

write.description: Host-internal: persist a pruned tool result under state/spills/<session>/<id>.txt (fields: session, id, content)
